title: Improvement Works of Manakkodam Lighthouse tower
summary: Improvement works to the lighthouse tower at Manakkodam Lighthouse, Alappuzha district, Kerala, under the Kochi Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

scope.item: Improvement Works of Manakkodam Lighthouse tower

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) and technical documents to be submitted physically by the deadline.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%

Similar works: construction of generator shed with truss work, concrete foundation and aluminium work / construction or maintenance of residential, institutional, office buildings, road, lighthouse tower or related civil works
CA-certified annual turnover for last three years
notes: Only Section-I NIT published; BOQ is in CPPP tender document. Bid submission 06.02.2026 18:00 to 24.02.2026 15:00; bid query last date 09.02.2026; last date of EMD 23.02.2026. Similar-works definition mentions generator shed construction, which looks carried over from another notice.
